# QAlaunch

> Website testing that finds what's broken — built and run by a QA engineer with
> 9 years of professional experience. Paste any public URL and QAlaunch loads the
> site in a real browser, then reports the problems a visitor would actually hit:
> broken buttons and links, mobile layout failures, forms that silently fail,
> accessibility barriers and slow pages. The free scan needs no signup, no email
> and no payment card.

QAlaunch is not an SEO tool. It does not report on backlinks, keyword rankings or
domain authority. It tests whether a website *works* for the people using it.

## What it does

- Loads the page in a real browser (Chromium via Browserbase), not a static fetch
- Checks mobile layout across five viewport widths
- Follows links and reports the ones that are dead
- Tests forms, buttons and interactive elements for silent failure
- Runs axe-core accessibility checks and Google PageSpeed
- Passes the real screenshots through an AI visual review for problems a
  rule-based checker cannot see, such as overlapping or invisible elements

## Who it is for

Small business owners, online shop owners, freelancers building client sites, and
people who built a site with an AI builder (Lovable, Bolt, Base44, Replit, v0,
Claude) and have no way to tell whether it actually works. Typical users are
non-technical: a plumber whose booking form may not deliver, a shop owner unsure
their checkout works on phones.

## Pricing

- Free scan — homepage, top issues shown, no signup or card required
- Basic — $9 one-time, one page, full report with screenshot evidence and fixes
- Standard — $24 one-time, 2–5 pages
- Premium — $59 one-time, 6–10 pages
- Done-for-you manual audit — $299, up to 10 pages tested by hand by a QA
  engineer, written report plus a 15-minute call, delivered in 3 business days

All one-time payments. No subscription.

## How it differs from similar tools

- Google Lighthouse scores how a page loads; it never clicks anything, so a
  button wired to nothing passes it without comment. QAlaunch interacts with the
  page.
- BrowserStack rents you browsers to test in yourself. QAlaunch does the testing
  and hands you the findings.
- SEO auditors (Semrush, Ahrefs, AIOSEO) report on search visibility. QAlaunch
  reports on whether the site functions.

## Limits, stated plainly

- Only publicly reachable pages are tested. Anything behind a login is not.
- The free scan covers the homepage only.
- Business logic specific to your company is not tested; that is what the manual
  audit exists for.
